analyzed_vuln.description: ParseOldAtomList performs unchecked direct indexing into the input line (`text[4]`, and in the default error path `text[14]`) without validating that the line is long enough. For malformed/truncated old atom-list property lines, this causes an out-of-bounds read on the stack-backed std::string buffer (ASan reports at line 253 when formatting the error message with `text[14]`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Through `MolDataStreamToMol` -> `ParseV2000CTAB` -> `ParseMolBlockProperties`, the first properties line after atoms/bonds is treated as an old atom-list line whenever it does not start with M/A/V/G/S. If attacker-controlled mol data provides such a short line (e.g., length <5 or <15), `ParseOldAtomList` is called and indexes fixed offsets without length checks, triggering stack-buffer-overflow read.
